title: TelemetryLine
description: One line of telemetry.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): one line a second. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t strictly increases.

memory_mb.description: The app's memory footprint in MB.

cpu.description: The app's CPU use in percent of one core; it can pass 100.

free_disk_mb.description: Free space on the phone in MB.

queue.description: Frames waiting for the keyframe and candidate stages.

candidates_blurred.description: Candidates blurred since the recording opened.

candidates_dropped.description: Candidates dropped since the recording opened.
